sloka: गतो हि लक्ष्मणः पूर्वं भरतश्च महायशाः ।श्रुत्वा तु वचनं तस्य शत्रुघ्नः परमासनात् ।। ७.४४.१० ॥
transliteration: gato hi lakṣmaṇaḥ pūrvaṁ bharataśca mahāyaśāḥ ।śrutvā tu vacanaṁ tasya śatrughnaḥ paramāsanāt ।। 7.44.10 ॥

translations.english: The doorkeeper also informed Shatrughna that Lakshmana had already gone, and the greatly renowned Bharata too, and upon hearing these words, Shatrughna rose from his excellent seat.
